summary: Defines a TLS extension to fix a renegotiation attack in which an attacker connects to a server, injects content, and then splices in a new connection from a victim. The extension cryptographically ties a renegotiation to the earlier handshake. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: A trickster could cut into a conversation and make the listener think it was one person talking. This fix lets both sides prove a new conversation continues the old one.

questions: what is the tls renegotiation indication extension
how was the tls renegotiation attack fixed
